unit: Scoring unit is a visually inspected row: one adult or one five-age lifecycle. Frame coverage is separately deduplicated.

distinctiveness: Repeated-looking within the shown same-source cohort
Minor changes mainly scale, color, or small posture
Strong, varied individual silhouettes and feature combinations
coherence: Frequent displaced, merged, or unclear features
Clean feature tracking and legible anatomy throughout
richness: Mostly size/proportion changes within one family
Striking, coherent transformations across the sequence
continuity: Severe visual jumps or missing tissue
Milestone sequence appears consistent with minor issues
Smoothly related sequence with stable features

limitations: Milestone sheets support sequence consistency, not proof of continuous-time smoothness. Richness and continuity are inapplicable to adult-only overview rows. Species recognition is descriptive, not a pass/fail criterion. Birth source equality across seeds is expected. Numerical pixel difference cannot supply these visual scores.
reviewReceipts: Reviewers inspect blind PNG pages, record pageId+actual rowIds and scores0..3, notes and observed defect IDs; null for dimensions without context. Reviews are agent reviews unless kind=human with an actual human reviewer. No inferred or generated automatic scores.
